verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a public REST API and webhooks for programmatically accessing/acting on issues, accounts, and contacts (pylon-docs-31, pylon-docs-32, pylon-docs-4), plus an MCP server that lets AI tools read/update the same core objects (pylon-docs-34, pylon-probe-rt-3). However, there's no evidence the API/MCP surface covers the full breadth of UI capabilities shown in the changelog (custom object forms, analytics dashboards, chat widget branding/customization, knowledge base authoring, triggers/automation config) — these appear UI-only in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP parity for analytics dashboards, chat widget customization, knowledge base management, and workflow/trigger configuration.
